description: This Java class 'ServerHitBin' tracks and manages server hit statistics, including request, event, view, entity, and service hits. It handles binning of data over time, persistence of hit data, and maintains global and per-identifier statistics.

classes.name: ServerHitBin
classes.description: A class for tracking server hit statistics, including counts, timing metrics, and binning over time intervals. It supports persistence and hierarchical counting.

methods.name: countRequest
methods.description: Increments request hit count for a given ID and request context.

methods.name: countEvent
methods.description: Increments event hit count for a given ID and request context.

methods.name: countView
methods.description: Increments view hit count for a given ID and request context.

methods.name: countEntity
methods.description: Increments entity hit count for a given ID and request context.

methods.name: countService
methods.description: Increments service hit count for a given ID and request context.

methods.name: countHit
methods.description: Core method to record a hit, manage bin expiration, and persist data.

methods.name: countHitSinceStart
methods.description: Updates cumulative hit counts since server start for a given ID.

methods.name: makeIdTenantAware
methods.description: Appends tenant ID to the base ID if present.

methods.name: getNewBinLength
methods.description: Retrieves and constrains the bin length in milliseconds based on properties.

methods.name: getEvenStartingTime
methods.description: Calculates the aligned start time for bins, evenly divided into an hour.
